idea-plugin.name: Obsidian Pink Cyberpunk
idea-plugin.description:
Obsidian Pink Cyberpunk Theme

A sleek, high-contrast dark theme inspired by Obsidian Cyberpunk aesthetics.

  • Deep obsidian black backgrounds (#0f0c16)
  • Vibrant neon cyber pink accents (#ff2a85)
  • Electric purple highlights (#bd93f9)
  • Full support for RustRover, CLion, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and all JetBrains IDEs.
